r04.
Neither NATS nor RabbitMQ is used. Webhooks use an in-process buffered Go channel, `asyncPostQueue`, declared with capacity 128 in `internal/webhook/webhook.go:39`; four goroutines consume it (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:42-54`), and `PostAsync` enqueues deliveries (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:184-196`).
